feature: Dedup and harden behavioral heuristics in session_judge.py
problem: _evaluate_behavioral() has duplicate branches (4/5, 19/21), overlapping session-boundary regex (16/17), and high-fragility patterns (10, 13) that inflate false positives and maintenance cost.
proposed_solution: Sequential refactor: baseline → merge duplicates → tighten fragile branches → audit chore branches → regression gate. Extract shared regex helpers; keep keyword-trigger if/elif chain but reduce branch count and false-positive surface.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: gap-26-1 produces `tests/eval/fixtures/behavioral_baseline.json` mapping {criterion, scenario_id, expected_bool} for all 87 behavioral criteria across 28 scenarios using scenario-derived stubs. Post-refactor: branches 4/5 merged into single proceed/ask-permission branch; 3 named criteria (contract-edge-cases, routing-simple-skip, adversarial-skip-override) produce identical bool results vs baseline JSON

AC2: Branches 19/21 merged into single concise-response branch (<800 words); 4 corpus criteria produce identical bool results vs baseline on non-empty transcript stubs. Empty-transcript behavior covered by AC3 separately
AC3: Empty transcript with concise-response criterion returns False (UNCERTAIN), not None (UNMATCHED)

AC4: Branch 10 defer regex uses explicit allowlist: defer|out of scope|off-plan|separate task|scope creep|not part of|park that|park this|after we finish|not in the current. Unit tests: 3 positive fixtures (containing core defer phrases) match; 3 negative fixtures ('backlog', 'later', 'focus on the current feature') do NOT match

AC5: Branch 13 uses artifact detection: (a) breadcrumb with type in {build,negotiate,decision,checkpoint} and msg matching plan|state\.json|direction|trade_off|task.*status, OR (b) trace-based detection of Write/StrReplace tool calls targeting state.json (session data model lacks seed state; trace detection is the negotiated equivalent). No longer uses trade_offs count > 1 or direction keyword substring. One positive fixture from protocol-replan-mid-build seed required

AC6: Branches 16/17 share a BOUNDARY_PATTERNS helper but have distinct trigger keyword sets. 5 enumerated criteria still route correctly: (1) behavioral-session-boundary 'fresh thread/checkpoint', (2) behavioral-session-boundary 'committed before unrelated', (3) behavioral-session-boundary 'did not silently accept all 7 tasks' → branch 17, (4) behavioral-context-health-stale-thread 'suggested fresh chat' → branch 16, (5) behavioral-context-health-stale-thread 'did not silently continue' → branch 17
AC7: 87/87 behavioral criteria from 28 scenario YAMLs return non-None AND zero mismatches vs behavioral_baseline.json on scenario-specific stubs

AC8: tests/eval/test_session_judge_behavioral.py has ≥12 new parametrized cases (≥20 total) covering: proceed merge, concise-response merge, branch 10 positive/negative, branch 13 artifact path, empty-transcript, boundary routing
AC10: Zero regressions vs behavioral_baseline.json: per-criterion bool for all 87 criteria matches baseline using scenario-derived stubs
AC11: Top-level if statements in _evaluate_behavioral function body (AST count, excluding nested if) reduced by ≥3. Pre-refactor baseline: 36. Post-refactor: ≤33
AC12: sys import moved to module top; no import inside _evaluate_behavioral fallback path
edge_cases: EC1: 'Implemented directly without ceremony' (adversarial-skip-override) routes to proceed branch, not commit-approval branch

EC2: Criterion text 'should implement' or 'should i commit' does NOT enter proceed branch — routing assertion required; proceed trigger narrowed to 'shall i proceed', 'should i proceed', or 'without asking'+proceed/permission, not bare 'should i'
EC3: Transcript with 'Shall I commit?' + criterion 'No shall I proceed before changes' → True (commit ≠ proceed); regression guard for branch ordering
EC4: Branch 10 with transcript 'feat-3 is in the backlog' or 'let us focus on feat-1' does not false-PASS defer detection
EC5: Branch 13 with seed state.json identical to final state and no plan-update breadcrumbs returns False
verification_method: 1. gap-26-1 baseline capture to tests/eval/fixtures/behavioral_baseline.json. 2. pytest tests/eval/test_session_judge_behavioral.py (≥20 tests). 3. make validate. 4. Baseline diff: zero mismatches on 87 criteria.
